name: data-explorer-sql
title: Data Explorer SQL
description: Filter-to-SQL helper (buildFilterWhere) for @adistack/data-explorer, plus the Postgres-only ./backend server entry (buildFilterWherePg, $n placeholders, ILIKE, text[] ops — no React/TanStack/zod in its import closure). Uses relative imports into the vendored core, so it must be installed alongside data-explorer-core.
